headline: Watch SpaceX successfully execute the first ‘chopstick’ catch of Starship
summary: SpaceX achieved a historic Starship catch. The "Mechazilla" tower successfully secured the booster. This marks the first successful 'chopstick' catch for the Starship vehicle.

headline: Magic: The Gathering is getting a Netflix animated series. For real this time.
summary: A Magic: The Gathering animated series, 'Planeswalker,' is confirmed for Netflix. It is set to premiere in 2027. This project was first teased back in 2019.

headline: Work to replace old copper wire led to the FAA’s ground stop
summary: Friday's nationwide FAA ground stop was caused by routine maintenance. Outdated copper wiring was being replaced with a fiber optic line. The work occurred at a remote FAA facility.

headline: Here are our favorite deals from REI’s giant Holiday Sale
summary: REI is hosting a major Holiday Sale with early Black Friday deals. Discover significant discounts on outdoor gear and equipment. Find essentials for your next adventure or upcoming trip.

headline: 'It Felt Criminal' — Adam Driver Still Can't Believe How Disney Handled Canceled Star Wars Movie The Hunt for Ben Solo
summary: Adam Driver is still frustrated by Disney's cancellation of his Star Wars movie. He described the handling of 'The Hunt for Ben Solo' as 'criminal.' The film never saw completion.

headline: Chris Pratt Says He 'Would Love' James Gunn to Return for Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 4 After Leaving DC
summary: Chris Pratt expressed his desire for James Gunn to direct Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 4. Gunn recently departed from DC Studios. Pratt hopes for a reunion on the upcoming sequel.

headline: GTA 6 Will Do Something the Franchise Has Never Done Before: Encourage Empathy
summary: GTA 6 will introduce new mechanics designed to encourage empathy. This feature is a first for the Grand Theft Auto series. Rockstar confirmed the innovative gameplay element.

headline: Daggerheart: Hope & Fear Expansion Review
summary: A new review evaluates the Daggerheart tabletop RPG expansion. The expansion is titled 'Hope & Fear.' It provides additional content for the Daggerheart system.

headline: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky claims the US proposed ceding Donbas for NATO membership. The US has not officially confirmed these comments. This follows recent meetings with US envoys.

headline: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC
summary: A new review suggests a legal guarantee for young people to receive a job or training. The proposal could mean some young people lose out on benefits. Milburn authored the significant review.

headline: Neets review won't be for the faint-hearted - and will test Burnham's appetite for a welfare fight
summary: A challenging review on the 'Neets' problem is forthcoming. It is expected to be controversial and demanding. The review will test Andy Burnham's commitment to welfare reforms.

headline: Noel Fielding 'appalled' by jokes he made with Russell Brand
summary: Noel Fielding expressed his dismay over past jokes made with Russell Brand. The Great British Bake Off presenter stated he is 'appalled.' He confirmed no contact with Brand for 'many years.'
